FUNCTION MAX_IN_WINDOW ACCEPTS(arr, window_size)
  result <- EMPTY LIST
  FOR i FROM 0 TO LENGTH OF arr - window_size
    max_value <- NEGATIVE_INFINITY
    FOR j FROM i TO i + window_size - 1
      IF arr[j] > max_value THEN
        max_value <- arr[j]
      END IF
    END FOR
    result <- result + [max_value]
  END FOR
  RETURN result
END FUNCTION
